ingredients.name: chicken breasts, boneless and with skin
lemon juice, for the garlic sauce

steps.instruction: Mix the juice of 2 lemons with 6 cloves of garlic and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Add 1 teaspoon each of pepper and basil, and 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne pepper.
Put 4 chicken breasts in a deep pan and pour the marinade over them.
Cover the pan and let the chicken marinate in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, flip the chicken and marinate 4 more hours.
Drain the pan and keep the liquid.
Bake the chicken for 10 minutes, just to brown it.
steps.spoken: Bake the chicken for 10 to 15 minutes, just to brown the outside. It will finish in the long, slow bake that follows. Wash your hands after handling raw chicken.

steps.instruction: Pour the saved liquid back over the browned chicken.
Cover the pan tightly with foil and put it back in the oven.
Set the oven to 250 °F and bake for 4 hours.
steps.spoken: Set the oven to 250 °F and bake for 4 hours. Baste the chicken with the liquid in the pan every hour.

steps.instruction: Add the 6 sliced potatoes to the pan.
Baste everything with the liquid in the pan.
Cover the pan with foil again.
Put the pan back in the oven for 1 hour.
Blend 4 cloves of garlic and 1/2 cup of olive oil in a food processor.
Add 1/4 cup of lemon juice, 1/4 teaspoon of salt and a dash of cayenne.
Blend until smooth to make the garlic sauce.
Serve the chicken and potatoes with the garlic sauce.
